title: Romantic Escape to Vietnam with FREE Halong Bay Cruise Experience
highlights: Experience a romantic vacation in Vietnam as you explore its top attractions, from the vibrant streets of Hanoi to the iconic landmarks of Ho Chi Minh City.
Admire the beauty of Hanoi’s One Pillar Pagoda, an 11th-century Buddhist temple, known for its unique lotus-shaped design.
Enjoy sailing through the stunning limestone formations and emerald waters of Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
Journey through time and tradition at the Phuc Kien Assembly Hall in Hoi An, with altars dedicated to various deities of the Fujian community.
Wander through the ornate halls of Vinh Trang Pagoda, a fusion of Vietnamese, Khmer, and Chinese architecture, and marvel at the giant Buddha statues and tranquil gardens.
overview:
About the Tour:
Your journey through Vietnam on this honeymoon tour combines vibrant cityscapes, serene coastlines, and deep cultural experiences. Begin by exploring Hanoi's Old Quarter, cycling through the lively streets, and visiting the iconic One Pillar Pagoda. Cruise through Halong Bay, where emerald waters meet limestone islands, then sail the Thu Bon River in Hoi An. The Cu Chi Tunnels and a boat ride along the Mekong Delta reveal Vietnam’s layered history and natural beauty. Every day is crafted to provide romantic moments and unforgettable adventures in this enchanting country.


This tour also takes you to Da Nang's Marble Mountains, where you can explore caves and visit pagodas nestled within the peaks. In Hoi An, enjoy a peaceful stroll through the Ancient Town’s colorful streets or cruise along the Thu Bon River for a romantic sunset view. In Ho Chi Minh City, explore the vibrant Ben Thanh Market and the historical Cu Chi Tunnels. Every aspect of this journey is designed for couples to savor intimate moments amidst Vietnam’s natural and cultural beauty.

know_before_you_go: Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
Images are for representation purposes only.
Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as proof of identity.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change during peak season and blackout dates.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.

As per Indian Govt. rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Kindly consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Hanoi! Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, you’ll get transferred to the hotel for check in. You can relax for the day or explore the beautiful city on your own. Visit places like the Hanoi Opera House, Hoa Bình Dam, and Ba Vi National Park, among other attractions. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Hanoi Sightseeing Tour | Cycling Tour of Old Quarter
days.desc: Prepare yourself for an amazing experience as you get driven for a sightseeing tour of Hanoi. Begin the exploration with a visit to the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum Complex, dedicated to the great Vietnamese leader - Ho Chi Minh. Admire the One-Pillar Pagoda and Chua Tran Quoc. Also, explore the Bat Trang Ceramic Village, and Temple Of Literature before going for the cycling tour around the Old Quarters. Later, you’ll get driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Cruise Experience
days.desc: Get ready for an amazing cruise experience by checking out of the hotel and getting driven to the Tuan Chao Harbour. Then, board your Halong Bay cruise, and enjoy the scenic views of islands and caves. Later, visit the Ti Top Island, and Pearl Farm Village by boat and enjoy activities like kayaking and swimming. Upon returning to the cruise, participate in a Vietnamese cooking class. As the day winds down, settle into your comfortable cabin on the cruise ship and enjoy your overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Halong Royal Palace Cruise
Halong Bay Overnight Cruise on a Shared basis
items.desc:
Board the cruise for Halong Bay from Tuan Chao Harbor and check-in into your cabin. Enjoy the scenery while sipping the welcome drink. Reach Tiptop Island and relax. 
Explore Pearl Farm Village by boat and enjoy water activities like Kayaking and swimming in the bay. Return to the cruise. Afterwards, join the cooking classes on Vietnamese-styled food. 
Enjoy the overnight stay at the cruise.

days.title: Transfer to Da Nang via Hanoi
days.desc: Wake up to the stunning scenery of Halong Bay. While still on the cruise, enjoy a Tai Chi lesson, a traditional Chinese martial art. Afterwards, deboard the cruise and visit Halong Bay's largest cave, the Surprise Caves. Return to Tuan Chao Harbour and transfer to Noi Bai International Airport for your flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival at Da Nang International Airport, get a transfer to your hotel and check in for an overnight stay.

items.title: Halong Bay Half-Day Cruise on a Shared basis
items.desc:
Begin your day by practicing Tai Chi, the Chinese martial art, on the Sundeck. 
Next, explore the seven new wonders of the world in Halong Bay.
Next, take a small passenger boat to reach Surprise Cave (Sung Sot), Halong Bay's largest cave spanning 12,000 square meters and admire its natural scenery.
Get back on the cruise and head to Tuan Chau Harbor.

days.title: Hoi An Day Tour with Boat Ride in Thu Bon River
days.desc: Start your day with a visit to Hoi An as you get transferred from the hotel and explore the narrow lanes filled with centuries-old houses showcasing Japanese, Chinese, and European architecture. Visit the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge and explore the Assembly Hall Of Fujian. Then, enjoy a peaceful boat trip around My Tho, famous for floating markets, and immense rice fields. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Ho Chi Minh City | Leisure Day
days.desc: On this day, check out of the hotel and get transferred to the Da Nang International Airport to board your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Upon arrival at Tan Son Nhat International Airport, you’ll get driven to the hotel for check in. After relaxing for a while, you can head out to explore the city on your own. Visit places like the Saigon River, Ho Chi Minh City Hall, and the Mariamman Hindu Temple, among other attractions. Afterwards, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Deluxe Hotel
items.hotel: Lotus Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh

days.title: Cu Chi Tunnels Visit | Ho Chi Minh City Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven for a visit to Cu Chi Tunnels, an underground network used by the Viet Cong during the war. Next, proceed with a Ho Chi Minh City tour, starting at the Reunification Palace, a historic site symbolising Vietnam's victory. Then, visit the War Remnants Museum, which delves into the history of the Vietnam War, followed by the Saigon Central Post Office, showcasing a blend of neo-classical European architecture and Asian design. Later, get driven to the hotel for overnight stay.

days.title: Mekong Delta Tour
days.desc: Get ready for an exciting day on the Mekong Delta tour. Board your pre-booked transfer from the hotel to My Tho city, passing through the lush green landscapes of rice paddies. Enjoy a boat ride along the Mekong River, where you can observe fishermen using fish cages from their unique floating houses. Visit the Vinh Trang Pagoda, the largest pagoda in the Mekong Delta. Afterwards, you’ll get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.
